title: Machine Learning for Subtyping Concussion Using a Clustering Approach
summary: PCA and agglomerative clustering identified five concussion symptom-profile groups among 275 clinic patients, with differences on clinical measures. The clusters are data-derived and lack independent replication or proof that they represent distinct biological subtypes.
ai_technology: Principal-component reduction and agglomerative clustering identify symptom-profile subtypes in concussion patients.
organization: Advance Concussion Clinic Inc., Vancouver, BC, Canada
